driver: STM32N6 CRC LL independent data register: input-assisted two-function development

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 26 (CRC) + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.26 CRC register interface + memory map p.176 (CRC secure base 0x56024C00)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the CRC benchmark work orders

scope: Write and read the general-purpose 32-bit independent data register (CRC_IDR.IDR), using only LL_CRC_Write_IDR and LL_CRC_Read_IDR.

Caller supplies a valid CRC peripheral instance with the register interface accessible; caller-owned clock, power, security and access setup is a precondition, not implemented or inferred by these LL functions.

Within this slice no LL call occurs automatically at startup, no status-flag polling or error return is specified for valid accessible calls, and invalid pointers or inaccessible hardware are outside the supported invocation domain.
Out of scope: CRC calculation/feed, polynomial configuration, initial CRC value, reversal, calculation-unit reset, DMA, HAL, other LL functions and autonomous factory modification.

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 CRC LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects CRC_S at 0x56024C00).

scope.note: Prospective new IDR objective; does not relabel or reset the exhausted full-CRC mission.
